purpose: The database layer (SQLite): children, settings, sessions, answers, points, avatar, shop, repeat bin, parent secrets, backups and migrations.
details: Everything that is stored goes through the Opslag class (golden rule 4). Answers are only ever added, never changed (a database trigger aborts any UPDATE on them), every record has a UUID, and the schema grows only by appending a script to MIGRATIES (currently 5 versions; a copy of the database is made before any migration). Reading uses _lees/_een (a failure gives an empty or default result and sets `probleem`), writing uses _schrijf (a failure rolls back and sets `probleem`), so the child never sees a crash or lost work. A daily backup goes to the 'reserve' folder (7 kept) and is refreshed on closing; a corrupt file is set aside and the newest good backup restored; if even opening fails the program runs on an in-memory database and warns that progress is not saved.
module_docstring: De databank (SQLite): kinderen, instellingen per kind, sessies en antwoorden.

constants.name: _IN_KINDEREN
constants.explanation: Settings fields stored in the children table instead of the settings JSON.

registries.name: MIGRATIES
registries.description: Ordered list of SQL scripts; _migreer runs those after the stored schema version. v1 children, settings, sessions, answers (with the append-only trigger); v2 child PIN and expected answer; v3 repeat bin; v4 points log and avatar; v5 shop ownership and saved outfits.

classes.name: OpslagFout
classes.explanation: Error for a database that cannot be used (for example from a newer program version, or an unknown child).

classes.name: Kind
classes.explanation: Frozen dataclass with a child's id, name and school year.

classes.name: Opslag
classes.explanation: The single gateway to the SQLite database; see the file description for the safety rules it follows.

methods.name: __init__
methods.explanation: Opens the SQLite file (or memory), turns on foreign keys, row access by name, and migrates the schema; closes the connection again when that fails.

methods.name: open
methods.docstring: Opent de databank in de datamap en maakt (één keer per dag) een reservekopie.
methods.explanation: Opens the database in the data folder, creating the folder; restores from backup when the file is corrupt; falls back to memory with a warning when opening is impossible; makes today's backup and imports the legacy settings JSON.

methods.name: controleer
methods.docstring: Geeft een sqlite3.DatabaseError als het bestand beschadigd is.
methods.explanation: Runs quick_check and raises a DatabaseError (after closing) if the database is damaged.

methods.name: reserve_map
methods.explanation: The 'reserve' folder next to the database.

methods.name: _kopie
methods.docstring: Een veilige kopie (sqlite-backup, ook terwijl de databank open is). Mag nooit crashen.
methods.explanation: Makes a safe copy through SQLite's backup API (also while open) with the given file name; returns the path or None; never raises.

methods.name: dagkopie
methods.docstring: Eén reservekopie per dag; de oudste verdwijnen (er blijven er DAGKOPIEEN).
methods.explanation: Makes today's backup if missing and prunes old daily backups to the newest 7.

methods.name: _herstel
methods.docstring: Het bestand is beschadigd: zet het opzij en zet de nieuwste goede reservekopie terug.
methods.explanation: For a corrupt file: moves it aside with a timestamp, restores the newest good backup (or starts fresh when none is good) and sets a message in `probleem`.

methods.name: versie
methods.explanation: The current schema version number from the database.

methods.name: _migreer
methods.explanation: Brings the schema up to date: creates the version table, refuses a database from a newer program, copies the database first when migrating an existing one, and runs each missing migration script in a transaction with rollback on error.

methods.name: _schrijf
methods.docstring: Een schrijfopdracht die het programma nooit laat crashen.
methods.explanation: Executes a write statement and commits; on an integrity error rolls back and re-raises, on other SQLite errors rolls back, sets `probleem` and returns False.

methods.name: _lees
methods.docstring: De rijen van een leesopdracht. Lukt lezen niet (bv. de databank is vergrendeld of beschadigd), dan een lege lijst en een melding: het programma mag daardoor nooit crashen.
methods.explanation: Executes a read and returns all rows; on an SQLite error sets `probleem` and returns an empty list.

methods.name: _een
methods.explanation: The first row of a read, or the default when there is none.

methods.name: sluit
methods.docstring: Sluit de databank en ververst de reservekopie van vandaag (zo is een teruggezette kopie zo recent mogelijk: van de laatste keer dat het programma gewoon afgesloten werd).
methods.explanation: Closes the database and (if nothing went wrong) refreshes today's backup first.

methods.name: algemeen
methods.explanation: Reads a general key/value setting (last child, parent password and PIN hashes, ...).

methods.name: zet_algemeen
methods.explanation: Writes or updates a general key/value setting.

methods.name: kinderen
methods.explanation: All children (id, name, year) sorted by name.

methods.name: kind
methods.explanation: One child by id, or None.

methods.name: nieuw_kind
methods.explanation: Creates a child with validated settings (name and year in the children table, the rest as JSON in the settings table) and returns it.

methods.name: _data
methods.explanation: Serialises settings to JSON without the fields that live in the children table (name, year).

methods.name: instellingen_van
methods.explanation: A child's settings: JSON data plus name and year from the children table, validated; raises OpslagFout for an unknown child.

methods.name: bewaar_instellingen
methods.explanation: Stores validated settings (name and year in the children table, the rest as JSON).

methods.name: zet_om_uit_json
methods.docstring: Fase 1 bewaarde instellingen in een JSON-bestand: maak daar één kind van (eenmalig).
methods.explanation: Once: when the legacy instellingen.json exists and there are no children, turns it into the first child, makes it the last chosen child and renames the file to .oud.

methods.name: start_sessie
methods.explanation: Inserts a new session row and returns its id.

methods.name: sluit_sessie
methods.explanation: Sets the end time of a session that is still open.

methods.name: bewaar_antwoord
methods.explanation: Inserts one answer (never updates): time, day, skill, year, mode, key, question, given answer, correct, diagnosis, duration, hint use, extra JSON and the expected answer text.

methods.name: telling
methods.docstring: (aantal, juist) voor een kind tussen twee dagen (JJJJ-MM-DD of date, beide inbegrepen).
methods.explanation: (number of answers, number correct) of a child between two days inclusive.

methods.name: antwoorden
methods.docstring: Alle antwoorden van een kind, eventueel tussen twee dagen (beide inbegrepen), oudste eerst.
methods.explanation: All answers of a child, optionally between two days, oldest first, as dicts.

methods.name: laatste_antwoorden
methods.docstring: De laatste antwoorden van een kind, nieuwste eerst (het logboek voor de ouder, #24).
methods.explanation: The last N answers of a child, newest first (the parent's log).

methods.name: antwoord_met_sleutel
methods.docstring: Het laatste antwoord op deze vraag tot en met dit tijdstip (bv. bij een punt in het logboek), of None.
methods.explanation: The latest answer to a question key up to a time, or None (links a points entry to its question).

methods.name: sessie_overzicht
methods.docstring: Afgesloten sessies van één soort: [{start, aantal, juist, tijd_ms}], oudste eerst.
methods.explanation: Closed sessions of one mode and skill with number of answers, correct and total time, oldest first.

methods.name: gezien_sleutels
methods.docstring: Vraagsleutels die dit kind sinds die dag al kreeg (om herhaling te vermijden).
methods.explanation: The set of question keys a child answered for a skill since a day (used to avoid repeats).

methods.name: recente_antwoorden
methods.explanation: The newest answers for a skill (newest first), optionally excluding some modes.

methods.name: recente_antwoorden_van_sessies
methods.docstring: De nieuwste antwoorden uit sessies met deze vaardigheid (bv. snelrekenen.tafels), wat de vragen ook waren.
methods.explanation: The newest answers from sessions of a given session-skill (for example speed practice), whatever skill each question had.

methods.name: al_juist
methods.docstring: Had dit kind deze exacte vraag ooit al juist? (dan levert ze geen punten meer op)
methods.explanation: True when the child ever answered this exact question key correctly (then it earns no points).

methods.name: punten_bij
methods.explanation: Adds an entry to the points log (positive or negative) with a reason and optional question key; ignores zero.

methods.name: punten_saldo
methods.explanation: The child's points balance (sum of the log).

methods.name: punten_log
methods.explanation: The last N points entries, newest first.

methods.name: avatar
methods.explanation: The child's stored avatar config, or None.

methods.name: bewaar_avatar
methods.explanation: Stores or updates the child's avatar config.

methods.name: bezit
methods.explanation: Everything the child bought (layer, key, price, delivered, delivery condition) in purchase order.

methods.name: zet_bezit
methods.explanation: Records a purchase (or updates the delivered flag of an existing one).

methods.name: lever
methods.explanation: Marks a purchased item as delivered.

methods.name: sinds
methods.docstring: (juiste antwoorden, totale antwoordtijd in ms) sinds een tijdstip.
methods.explanation: (correct answers, total answer time in ms) since a timestamp, used for package progress.

methods.name: outfits
methods.explanation: The child's saved avatar combinations.

methods.name: bewaar_outfit
methods.explanation: Saves an avatar combination under a name.

methods.name: verwijder_outfit
methods.explanation: Deletes a saved combination.

methods.name: herhaal_zet
methods.explanation: Inserts or updates a repeat-bin item (one per child, skill and topic) with its data, bin and due day.

methods.name: herhaal_weg
methods.explanation: Removes a repeat-bin item.

methods.name: herhaalbak
methods.docstring: Items in de herhaalbak (alleen die tot en met tot_dag aan de beurt zijn, als die gegeven is).
methods.explanation: The repeat-bin items of a child, optionally only those due up to a day, with their data decoded.

methods.name: ouder_wachtwoord
methods.explanation: The parent password hash, or None.

methods.name: zet_ouder_wachtwoord
methods.explanation: Stores or (with None) deletes the parent password hash.

methods.name: ouder_pin
methods.docstring: De ouderpin (4 cijfers, gehasht): opent het slot op Stoppen (kern/stopslot.py).
methods.explanation: The parent PIN hash that opens the lock on quitting, or None.

methods.name: zet_ouder_pin
methods.explanation: Stores or (with None) deletes the parent PIN hash.

methods.name: pincode
methods.explanation: A child's PIN hash, or None.

methods.name: zet_pincode
methods.explanation: Stores a child's PIN hash.

methods.name: verwijder_kind
methods.docstring: Wist een kind met al zijn gegevens (instellingen, sessies, antwoorden).
methods.explanation: Deletes a child with all their data (cascade) and clears the 'last child' pointer if it was this child.

methods.name: sessies
methods.explanation: All sessions of a child, oldest first.

functions.name: _beschadigd
functions.docstring: Is dit een beschadigd bestand (en niet bv. een vergrendelde databank)?
functions.explanation: True when an exception means a corrupt database file (not a locked one).

functions.name: _goed
functions.docstring: Is dit databankbestand leesbaar en heel?
functions.explanation: True when a database file passes SQLite's quick_check.

functions.name: _ruim_op
functions.docstring: Houd alleen de nieuwste `bewaar` bestanden die op het patroon passen.
functions.explanation: Deletes the oldest files matching a pattern so only the newest N remain; ignores OS errors.

functions.name: _json
functions.docstring: JSON uit de databank lezen; is het beschadigd, dan de standaardwaarde (geen crash).
functions.explanation: Parses JSON text from the database, returning the default for damaged or missing text instead of raising.

functions.name: _nieuw_id
functions.explanation: A new UUID string for a record.
